author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before stacked an upright box with a dot over a separate trapezoid, losing the falling/into-basket relation. Redrawn: banknote tilted 1:3 sinking into the basket (lower half hidden behind the rim, ends joined to the rim), centre dot as the note mark, basket with lip, tapered sides and two ribs. Valid, gate pass.
omissions: The $ sign and corner triangles (a $ needs ~16x32; corner triangles leave sub-minimum holes); third basket rib (ribs must be 8 apart).
